mechanic_notes: Feeders provide low impact on animal potential; pollution and invasive plants have a high impact. For instance, white-tailed deer in Lake Sasquatch cannot reach 'Thriving' until Lake Sasquatch pollution is cleared and both feeders are installed.

tasks.name: Clear Invasive Flora: Thunderbird Muskeg (North)
tasks.description: Eradicate invasive plant populations in Thunderbird Muskeg to restore the natural feeding and cover habitat for wetland waterfowl and upland game birds.

tasks.name: Clear Invasive Flora: Thunderbird Muskeg (Central)
tasks.description: Eradicate invasive plant populations in Thunderbird Muskeg to restore the natural feeding and cover habitat for wetland waterfowl and upland game birds.

tasks.name: Clear Invasive Flora: Thunderbird Muskeg (South)
tasks.description: Eradicate invasive plant populations in Thunderbird Muskeg to restore the natural feeding and cover habitat for wetland waterfowl and upland game birds.

tasks.name: Remediate Toxic Runoff: Lake Sasquatch East
tasks.description: Clear chemical pollution and hazardous waste from the eastern shore of Lake Sasquatch to allow deer herds to safely drink and achieve thriving fitness potential.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Slalakum Shore (Big Game)

tasks.name: Feed Station: Slalakum Shore (Ungulates)

tasks.name: Feed Station: Slalakum Shore North

tasks.name: Feed Station: Thunderbird Muskeg Northwest

tasks.name: Feed Station: Lake Sasquatch Southwest (Mixed)

tasks.name: Repair Footbridge: Kermode Plateau Southeast
